<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/products/{sku}/pack-levels"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Every pack level the product ever declared, retired ones included,
lowest level first and, within a level, oldest first, a page at a
time (`limit`, `cursor`; a response without `nextCursor` is the last
page). A product without pack levels answers an empty `items` array.
